BLUEPRINT PRESS

The combination you asked for:

· Blueprint's drafting grid, now drawn in faint navy on light stock
· Swiss Grid's palette — off-white, near-black, one red accent
· Editorial Press's type — Instrument Serif over Spectral

One change I made on purpose: the 'black' is #0B1A2B, the blueprint navy, not a true black. It keeps the whole page faintly blue and lets the mark belong.

Hover anything. The nav is clickable.

THE MARK

The B's curves are now ONE unbroken stroke that starts at the top of the stem and ends at its base — out, back, out further, back. It never lifts.

The navy→blue gradient runs along that travel, so the eye follows the direction of flow.

Four containers to choose from, plus how it holds up at favicon size (it needs a heavier stroke and flat blue below ~24px).

MOTION & CONTROLS

Twelve live treatments — hover them, click the segmented toggle.

They all share one easing curve so the site feels like one hand made it.

Tell me which ones you want and I'll build those into the real components. 07 (flowing border) is the loudest; 01 and 08 are the ones I'd use everywhere.
